description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map . No. 320236
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property details) in various villages in the Kandy District. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
